query: I need a website for an independent architecture practice. We have photos and a short bio but no clear site plan. Help us decide what to build before coding.
Build a campaign landing page for our community theatre. The current draft looks like every AI startup page. I want a reviewable direction first.
Redo my consultant portfolio and case-study site. I have old articles and a few project screenshots. Work out the complete path from brief to browser review.
Resume the website plan. Journeys are approved; only the design board and review remain. Do not redo the discovery.
For this museum website, decide what a first-time visitor and a researcher need, where they enter, and which pages belong in navigation. No styling yet.
Our photographer portfolio spec is just hero, gallery, about, contact. Rewrite it around visitor questions, proof and page purpose.
Define the brief for a single exhibition page. Visitors arrive from a QR code and should book a visit. We do not need a whole new site.
Help structure case studies on our studio website, including what claims need sources and what each page should help a buyer decide.
The website brief is approved. Develop a visual-system board and exact DESIGN.md for an experimental arts publication. Keep our existing logo.
Our artist portfolio feels generic. Define an image crop grammar, typography, color roles and signature visual idea grounded in the work.
Convert this approved website art direction into reusable design tokens and rules for mobile, focus states and reduced motion.
Make a brand-system board showing how our restaurant website should look across its homepage, menu and mobile booking path. The visitor brief is already done.
Challenge the draft website specification before coding. Look for unsupported claims, vague visual decisions and contradictions. Do not redesign it.
Inspect the rendered portfolio on desktop and mobile against our approved board, DESIGN.md and page acceptance criteria. Capture the final states.
The build passes. Can you review the website visually? I can only provide the source code right now, no screenshots or running URL.
Review only the contact menu and form error states on our finished campaign site. Keep the approved colors and layout.
Fix a typo in the approved site's footer: replace commision with commission. Do not change any design.
Repair the backend webhook signature check for our website. The frontend and visual design are unchanged.
Design a logo and printed business cards for my ceramics studio. I am not working on a website.
Our website design is approved. Fix only the CSS selector causing a one-pixel border bug; no strategy, new visual direction or review package.
